# V-Gears Lua Style Essentials

Full guide: [doc/STYLE-LUA.md](../../doc/STYLE-LUA.md).

- Indent with four spaces. Never use tabs.
- Variables: short `snake_case` (`front_color`); larger scope → more descriptive names.
- Functions and classes: `PascalCase`. Constants: `ALL_CAPS`. Module names: all `lowercase`.
- Always use `local` for variables and functions; avoid globals.
- Always close blocks with `end`; on long blocks, annotate the closing `end` with a comment (`end -- if`).
- One space after `--` in comments.
- Document every block of code with doxygen-style docstrings:

```lua
--[[
 Retrieves a bit variable.
 @param bank Memory bank (0-index, as in game).
 @return 1 or 0
]]
```

- Test for non-`nil` idiomatically: `if line then`, not `if line ~= nil then`.
- Note: Lua generated by the installer's script decompiler follows these rules on a best-effort basis — do not hand-reformat large generated files.
